reason: Clarify finite-sum cast helper without integer-power notation; add consumed positivity and budget helpers before their proofs.
exact_signatures: theorem atanSum_cast (q : Rat) (m : Nat) : (atanSum q m : Real) = sum i in range m, (-1)^i*((q : Real)^(2*i+1))^(-1)/(2*i+1)
theorem piApprox_positive (m : Nat) (hm : 1 <= m) : 0 < piApprox m
theorem radius_budget (L epsilon : Rat) (hL : 0 < L) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) : piError (termCount L epsilon)*L <= epsilon
definition_audit: The inverse finite-natural-power helper is algebraically identical to v2 integer-power formula; no producer or error target changed.
proof_plan: For positive pi approximation use the coarse universal bound for m>=4 and exact rational evaluation m=1,2,3. These finite base cases support an arbitrary-m theorem, not finite replacement for uniform proof. Budget uses Int.le_ceil and toNat nonnegative domination.
